notes.title: Make sure the set's ready - Sex Industry XXX is coming! 🎥

Get to know the world of adult entertainment as Sex Industry XXX launches this Saturday! Play as a passionate and ambitious 18+ director who's planning on making it big.

notes.title: Grab your camera and welcome on set! 🎥
notes.content:
Guess what? Our third game, Sex Industry XXX, is officially in development! Take part in the story of John, an ambitious director aiming to make it in the 18+ movie industry. Experience an unusual mix of clicker and a classic visual novel as you're trying to manage your business - casting, locations, random problems and every other aspect needs to be taken care of! Help Valiati on the way to his dream and make sure you shoot the best episodes you can - watch your gear, your cast's mood, try to balance between mundane and creative parts of the process to achieve the best result possible.

Make sure to wishlist the game! 

Got any questions or thoughts to share? Feel free to let us know!

Get ready for a thrilling adventure! 🎉
